row.notes: Team_Set_TimingPillBadge: mov rdx,[r12+0x4d8] loads the team's timing_tower_texture_path C string that the next call (0x144197b50, append) adds after '#overrides.osd.timing_tower.team_badges_hud.' in the NeStr at rsp+0x20 (rdi). A MidHook here can swap rdx for another key; r12 = the team record. race HUD badge label load; a hook may replace rdx (the label) with a core-owned C string

verify.notes: V1578 Disassembly: 0x14176030b is mov rdx,[r12+0x4d8] (8 bytes, instruction boundary) between the append of '.' (0x144197b50 via UNK_14570c9c6 = ".") and the append of the key; it only runs on the table 0/2, +0x58d == 0 branch. Table 1 (user team) never reaches it, it takes the entrant's custom badge path instead.
